elder_hall.name: Elder's Hall
elder_hall.description: The heart of the village. Each level opens another building slot and builds a little faster; every few levels add a place in the build queue and another outpost.

woodcutter.name: Woodcutter
woodcutter.description: Cuts wood in the forest around the village.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.description: Breaks stone from the hills around the village.

farm.name: Farm
farm.description: Grows grain, which feeds the village and its troops.

iron_mine.name: Iron Mine
iron_mine.description: Digs iron for weapons, armour and walls.

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.description: How much of each resource the village can keep; what comes in above it is lost. A village may build more than one.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: Trains infantry. Each level trains them faster, and higher levels open stronger troops.

stables.name: Stables
stables.description: Breeds horses and trains riders. Each level trains them faster, and higher levels open stronger riders.

shooting_range.name: Shooting Range
shooting_range.description: Trains archers, skirmishers and throwers. Each level trains them faster, and higher levels open stronger shooters.

heroes_hall.name: Hero's Hall
heroes_hall.description: Recruits generals, who lead armies and command garrisons. Each level lets the hero recover from wounds faster here, and every few levels allow another general.

scout_lodge.name: Scout Lodge
scout_lodge.description: Trains scouts, who ride out to see a horde before it arrives.

caravan_yard.name: Caravan Yard
caravan_yard.description: Keeps caravans to carry resources to allies and to the Holy City vault; each level adds more.

settlers_lodge.name: Settlers' Lodge
settlers_lodge.description: Trains settlers, who walk out to found new villages.

academy.name: Academy
academy.description: Studies the techs of the research tree and brings in the research every tech costs; what you learn helps all your villages.

outpost.name: Outpost
outpost.description: A camp on a nearby hex that gathers what the land gives: wood in forests, stone and iron in hills and mountains, grain on plains and lakes.

granary_temple.name: Granary-Temple
granary_temple.description: The stag-folk's own: a temple granary that brings in grain and feeds the troops for less.

stone_redoubt.name: Stone Redoubt
stone_redoubt.description: The bear-folk's own: a stone keep that makes the garrison harder to break.

longhouse_hall.name: Longhouse Hall
longhouse_hall.description: The wolf-folk's own: a longhouse where warriors eat less and train faster.

wall.name: Walls
wall.description: The walls round the village: hordes must break or climb them before they reach the garrison. Higher levels change wood for stone.

archer_tower.name: Archer Tower
archer_tower.description: A tower on the walls: its archers make the garrison strike harder while the walls stand.

gate_tower.name: Gate Tower
gate_tower.description: Strengthens the gate, so the walls take longer to batter down.

ballista.name: Ballista Platform
ballista.description: A great crossbow on the walls that smashes the horde's siege engines.

murder_holes.name: Murder Holes
murder_holes.description: Openings over the gate to rain stones on the attackers: the garrison defends better while the walls stand.

ditch.name: Moat
ditch.description: A moat before the walls: it keeps off battering and climbers and slows the building of siege engines; at higher levels it holds water.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Sees hordes coming from farther away, so the warning comes sooner.

forester.name: Forester
forester.description: Tends the woods so they grow back thick: 5% more wood per level, from fields and outposts alike. Needs a Woodcutter of level 5.

stonemason.name: Stonemason
stonemason.description: Dresses the stone as it comes in: 5% more stone per level. Needs a Quarry of level 5.

mill.name: Mill
mill.description: Grinds the grain so less goes to waste: 5% more grain per level. Needs a Farm of level 5.

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.description: Smelts the ore hotter: 5% more iron per level. Needs an Iron Mine of level 5.

hospital.name: Hospital
hospital.description: Tends the wounded: when the garrison holds its own village, 5% per level of its fallen get up again.

market.name: Market
market.description: Trades one resource for another, at better rates every level, and buys the hero's spare gear.

axe_levy.name: Axe Levy
axe_levy.description: Farmers with their wood axes: cheap, quick to raise, soon spent.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: A free man with spear, axe and shield: good at a little of everything.

spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description: Cheap, steady infantry that holds the walls and stops riders.

axeman.name: Axeman
axeman.description: Hits hard with a long axe, but his shield is small.

ambusher.name: Ambusher
ambusher.description: Waits in the brush and falls on archers before they can loose.

horse_cutter.name: Horse Cutter
horse_cutter.description: Hooked blades for the legs of horses: riders dread him.

warrior_of_perun.name: Warrior of Perun
warrior_of_perun.description: Sworn to the Thunderer: steady in the line and hard in the charge.

axe_warrior.name: Axe Warrior
axe_warrior.description: A seasoned axeman in mail who cleaves through shields.

follower_of_veles.name: Follower of Veles
follower_of_veles.description: Keepers of the herds and the old roads; they give ground slowly.

horse_butcher.name: Horse Butcher
horse_butcher.description: Long-hafted blades that bring down horse and rider together.

large_shield.name: Large Shield
large_shield.description: A wall of tall shields: slow, and almost impossible to break.

noble_spearman.name: Noble Spearman
noble_spearman.description: A boyar's son with a long spear and good mail; riders break on him.

champion_of_perun.name: Champion of Perun
champion_of_perun.description: The Thunderer's best: they strike first and fall last.

perun_axe.name: Perun's Axe
perun_axe.description: Axes blessed under the oak of Perun; nothing stands in front of them for long.

veles_chosen.name: Veles' Chosen
veles_chosen.description: Veles marks them for his own; they hold where others run.

chosen_shield.name: Chosen Shield
chosen_shield.description: The steadiest shields of the land, set where the line must not break.

warlords_guard.name: Warlord's Guard
warlords_guard.description: The warlord's own sworn men, the best armed in the land.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Shoots hard at infantry; riders cut them down.

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
skirmisher.description: Throws javelins and runs; quick on his feet.

poison_archer.name: Poison Archer
poison_archer.description: Arrows dipped in hemlock: a graze is enough.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Hunts boar in the deep forest; he does not miss twice.

noble_skirmisher.name: Noble Skirmisher
noble_skirmisher.description: Well-armed javelin men who hold their ground better than most.

poison_hunter.name: Poison Hunter
poison_hunter.description: Knows every poison of the marsh and the root.

onager.name: Onager
onager.description: A throwing engine that hurls stones into packed ranks; slow to move.

devana_hunter.name: Devana's Hunter
devana_hunter.description: Huntress of the goddess of the forest: swift and deadly.

thunder_thrower.name: Perun's Thunder Thrower
thunder_thrower.description: Hurls fire-pots that burst like Perun's lightning.

horseman.name: Horse Raider
horseman.description: Riders who strike hard and run down archers.

raider.name: Raider
raider.description: Light riders who carry off a great load and are gone before the alarm.

mounted_archer.name: Horse Archer
mounted_archer.description: Shoots from the saddle and rides out of reach.

bear_rider.name: Bear Rider
bear_rider.description: A warrior on a tamed bear: slow for a rider, terrible in the charge.

svarog_raider.name: Svarog's Raider
svarog_raider.description: Riders of Svarog's fire: the fastest and hardest strike the land has.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Rides out to see a horde's numbers before it arrives.

settler.name: Settler
settler.description: Founds a new village where you send them; no use in a fight.

forest_archer.name: Forest Archer
forest_archer.description: The lynx-folk's own: archers who strike from the trees.

river_barge.name: River Barge
river_barge.description: The beaver-folk's own: a river crew who carry a great load and hold firm.

border_rider.name: Border Rider
border_rider.description: The falcon-folk's own: light riders who see far and ride fast.

north.signature: Beasts and creatures of the old forests. Erratic and savage; they fight on past reason.

east.signature: Fast horse archers out of the steppe. They raid rather than stay, burn outposts far from their road and carry off more.

south.signature: Disciplined zealots in heavy ranks with crossbows. Slow, and they do not break easily.

west.signature: The Order's western host: knights and crossbows. Slow, and they do not break easily.

felling_axes.name: Felling Axes
felling_axes.description: Woodcutters and forest outposts cut 10% more wood.

two_field_rotation.name: Two-Field Rotation
two_field_rotation.description: Farms and grain outposts grow 10% more grain.

stone_splitting.name: Stone Splitting
stone_splitting.description: Quarries and hill outposts cut 10% more stone.

bog_iron.name: Bog Iron Smelting
bog_iron.description: Iron mines and outposts smelt 10% more iron.

three_field_rotation.name: Three-Field Rotation
three_field_rotation.description: A third field rests each year: 15% more grain.

palisade_stakes.name: Palisade Stakes
palisade_stakes.description: Troops defending their own village fight 10% better.

hidden_cellars.name: Hidden Cellars
hidden_cellars.description: Raiders find 25% less to carry off.

woodcraft.name: Woodcraft
woodcraft.description: Scouts are 10 points likelier to come back.

rite_of_perun.name: Rite of Perun
rite_of_perun.description: Perun's thunder: all troops strike 5% harder.

mokosh_blessing.name: Mokosh's Blessing
mokosh_blessing.description: Mokosh blesses the land: 5% more of everything.

veles_ward.name: Veles's Ward
veles_ward.description: Veles watches the herds: troops eat 10% less grain.

svarog_forge.name: Svarog's Forge
svarog_forge.description: Svarog's fire: troops train another 10% faster.

wind_riders.name: Wind Riders
wind_riders.description: Cavalry strikes 15% harder and scouts ride 20% faster. Needs the Winds of Stribog scroll.

ember_forged_arms.name: Ember-Forged Arms
ember_forged_arms.description: Infantry strikes and holds 10% better. Needs the Rite of Svarog's Forge scroll.

battle_fury.name: Battle Fury
battle_fury.description: +4% attack for every troop per rank.

shield_bearer.name: Shield Bearer
shield_bearer.description: +4% defense for every troop per rank.

hold_fast.name: Hold Fast
hold_fast.description: +5% for defenders at home per rank.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.description: Scouts from the hero's village travel 10% faster per rank.

keen_eyes.name: Keen Eyes
keen_eyes.description: Scouts from the hero's village are 5 points likelier to return per rank.

quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
quartermaster.description: Caravans from the hero's village carry 10% more per rank.

bear_cloak.name: Bear-hide Cloak
bear_cloak.description: From a cave bear of the north.

mokosh_thread.name: Thread of Mokosh
mokosh_thread.description: The spinner hides what is yours.

grey_stallion.name: Grey Stallion
grey_stallion.description: A warhorse of the old princes.

dobrynya.name: Dobrynya
dobrynya.title: The serpent-slayer prince
dobrynya.story: A prince's son who struck down the Zmey at the Puchai river. Bold in the charge, and a retinue to keep fed.

traits.name: Rallying cry
traits.description: His name alone makes men fight harder at their own gates.

vasilisa.name: Vasilisa
vasilisa.title: The forest huntress
vasilisa.story: She reads the forest like a letter. Her bow never misses, but she is no shield-wall fighter.

traits.name: Tracker
traits.description: Moves fast and teaches the scouts to come back alive.

volkh.name: Volkh
volkh.title: The wise volkhv
volkh.story: A priest of the old gods who knows herbs, stars and secrets. Wisdom over the sword.

traits.name: Healing rites
traits.description: Rises from wounds in half the time, and learns from every fight.

sadko.name: Sadko
sadko.title: The merchant rider
sadko.story: A gusli player turned the richest trader of Novgorod. Gold opens more gates than steel.

traits.name: Silver tongue
traits.description: Talks raiders out of a fifth of what they came for.

nastasya.name: Nastasya
nastasya.title: The shieldmaiden
nastasya.story: A polyanitsa of the steppe border who has never given ground. Slow to march, impossible to move.

traits.name: Unbreakable
traits.description: Her spearmen train faster and hold the walls longer.

ilya.name: Ilya
ilya.title: The old bogatyr
ilya.story: Thirty years he sat by the stove; then he rose stronger than any man. Strong in all things, slow to learn new ones.

traits.name: Strength of the earth
traits.description: Mother Earth hides him: he is wounded for less time.

ambush.name: Ambush the horde's road
ambush.description: Fell trees across the road and burn the fords: the next horde from the {front} sets out later.

scout.name: Ride beyond the border
scout.description: Count the next horde from the {front} with your own eyes: its size, its troops and its stance.

caravan.name: Find the lost caravan
caravan.description: A merchant's train went missing in the woods. Bring back what is left of it.

hoard.name: The smith's hoard
hoard.description: An old smith buried his best work under his hearth before the hordes came. Dig it up.

ruins.name: Search the ruins
ruins.description: Search the {site} in person: nothing guards it now.

savagery.name: Savagery
savagery.description: +4% attack for the horde per rank.

thick_hide.name: Thick Hide
thick_hide.description: +4% defense for the horde per rank.

dread.name: Dread
dread.description: The horde holds 6% longer before it breaks, per rank.

greed.name: Greed
greed.description: +12% carried off from a raid per rank.

kurgan.name: Kurgan
kurgan.description: A burial mound of the old chieftains.

sunken_shrine.name: Sunken Shrine
sunken_shrine.description: A shrine the marsh swallowed, its idols still dry inside.

stone_idol.name: Stone Idol
stone_idol.description: A four-faced idol, worn smooth by centuries of rain.

frozen_ruin.name: Frozen Ruin
frozen_ruin.description: Halls under the ice, warm at their heart.

stribog_winds.name: Winds of Stribog
stribog_winds.description: Teaches the Wind Riders' craft (a rare tech).

svarog_rite.name: Rite of Svarog's Forge
svarog_rite.description: Teaches forging with Svarog's Ember (a rare tech).

bridge.story: Beyond the Holy City the Kalinov Bridge crosses the Smorodina, the river of fire, from Nav to Yav, the living world, and every horde that comes walks over it. The volkhvs mean to raise it on from Yav to Prav, the realm of the gods: once the Ritual Arch joins it to Prav, the gods' light runs down the whole bridge and nothing from Nav can set foot on it again. The hordes know this, and will throw everything at the city on the night the arch is bound.

stages.name: Foundation Stones
stages.story: A road to Prav can't rise from common stone. The old builders left their first stones among the ruins they abandoned, and only stones that remember the old rites will carry the bridge on from Yav.

quests.story: Bring back a relic of the old builders from an ancient site: their mark, set in the first stone, binds the new span to the old bridge's end in Yav.

stages.name: The Oak Piers
stages.story: The piers that lift the bridge towards Prav are cut from the sacred oaks of the grove, but beasts of the North have made their lairs among the roots and nobody can fell a tree while they howl.

quests.story: Clear a monster lair: the volkhvs won't raise an axe in the grove while the beasts are there.

stages.name: The Iron Span
stages.story: Iron forged under Svarog's eye carries the road up into the sky. The forge must burn without break, fed by ore brought in through the passes.

quests.story: The forge is lit from the Holy City's own flame: weather a wave without the city losing Sanctity, or the flame gutters and the iron cracks.
The ore comes through the passes: hold a pass or a fort on a horde's road, so the smiths know the road can be kept.

stages.name: The Guardian Rails
stages.story: The rails are carved with the faces of guardians so that nothing from Nav can climb the new span to Prav, and every rail must be quenched before it will hold.

quests.story: The guardians' faces are copied from the old idols: bring back their likeness from an ancient site.
A rail is quenched in the blood of a beast of the North: clear a lair to give the carvers what they need.

stages.name: The Ritual Arch
stages.story: The arch at the top of the span opens onto Prav. It is bound with a torc of Svarog's fire, and once it stands, everything in Nav will come at once: Ritual Night.

quests.story: Forge the ritual torc from a Svarog's Ember: the volkhvs bind the arch with it, and without it the new span is only a road into Prav for the enemy.

site.name: Bring back a relic
site.description: Explore an ancient site while this stage is open.

lair.name: Clear a monster lair
lair.description: An army clears a lair of the North while this stage is open.

unscathed.name: Weather a wave unscathed
unscathed.description: A wave ends without the Holy City losing Sanctity since this stage began.

choke.name: Hold a strong point
choke.description: Win a field battle at a choke point or from a fort while this stage is open.

ritual.name: Craft the ritual torc
ritual.description: Forge the ritual torc from a Svarog's Ember.

ritualNight.story: With the arch raised, the volkhvs begin the rite that will join the bridge to Prav. Every horde in Nav feels it. Tonight they all come at once, from every front, to break the city before the last words are spoken.

won.title: The Kalinov Bridge holds
won.story: The last horde broke against the walls and the rite was finished. The Kalinov Bridge runs from Nav through Yav to Prav, the gods' light holds it end to end, the road from Nav is shut, and the bells of the Holy City ring for the first time in a generation. The old faith lives on, because you held.

lost.title: The Holy City has fallen
lost.story: The walls are breached and the sanctuary fires are out. The hordes pour over the Kalinov Bridge unopposed. Some of the people escaped into the forests, carrying the songs with them; perhaps one day they will try again.

jelen.name: Rod Jelena
jelen.story: The stag-folk of the river meadows: first to sow, first to harvest, their villages grow like spring grass. They were never riders.
jelen.arms: Its arms are those of Nizhny Novgorod (1781): a red stag walking, on silver.

rys.name: Rod Rysa
rys.story: The lynx-folk of the deep woods strike from the shadows of the trees and are gone before the horde can turn. Their elders trust old ways over new learning.
rys.arms: Its arms are those of Gomel (granted in 1781): a gold lynx lying, on blue.

medved.name: Rod Medvěda
medved.story: The bear-folk of the iron hills dig deep and build thick walls. They are slow to leave the den they have made.
medved.arms: Its arms are those of Yaroslavl (1672): a black bear upright with a gold poleaxe, on silver.

bobr.name: Rod Bobra
bobr.story: The beaver-folk know every river and ford; their barges carry what the roads cannot. Their homes are built for trade, not for siege.
bobr.arms: Its arms are those of Bobrov (1781): a beaver in its own colour, on silver.

sokol.name: Rod Sokola
sokol.story: The falcon-folk of the open steppe ride fast and see far; their scouts come home when others do not. They have little patience for stonework.
sokol.arms: Its arms are those of Sokołów Podlaski (seal of 1764): a falcon on an oak branch with a gold ring in its beak, on gold.

volk.name: Rod Volka
volk.story: The wolf-folk of the northern stone fields know the cold and the things that come out of it. Their thin soil feeds them poorly.
volk.arms: Its arms are those of Vovchansk (1781): a silver wolf running over green ground, on blue.
volk.best: Stone and cold resistance (against the North)

steps.title: Raise a building
steps.hint: Open your village and queue any building or field upgrade.
steps.story: The elder looks at the thin palisade and the half-empty fields. "Walls and bread first, child. Everything else grows from them."
how: Tap Village in the top bar.
Tap an empty plot or a building in the village.
Tap Build or Upgrade in the sheet.

steps.title: Train defenders
steps.hint: Build a Barracks and train any unit there.
steps.story: "The hordes do not wait for the harvest. Put spears in the hands of those who can hold them."
how: Build a Barracks on a free plot in the village (no free plot? Upgrade the Elder's Hall: each level opens one).
When it stands, open the Troops tab.
Pick a unit and a number, then tap Train.

steps.title: Claim an outpost
steps.hint: Tap a forest, hill, field or mine hex near your village and claim it.
steps.story: "The land around us is rich, and nobody tends it. Set a camp there before the beasts do."
how: Go back to the map.
Tap a forest, hills, plains, mountain or lake hex next to your village.
In the sheet, tap Claim beside Build an outpost.

steps.title: Send scouts
steps.hint: Build a Scout Lodge and send scouts at a horde, a camp or an ancient site.
steps.story: "Fear is what you feel about a thing you have not seen. Go and see it."
how: Build a Scout Lodge on a free plot in the village (no free plot? Upgrade the Elder's Hall).
Tap the threat line in the top bar.
Pick a horde and tap Send scouts.

steps.title: Clear your first camp
steps.hint: Send an army to storm a bandit camp or a lair (order: storm it).
steps.story: "A camp of beasts in the woods is a wave that has not yet happened. Burn it out."
how: Find a camp on the map: there is one near your village (the tents).
Tap it, choose your troops in the sheet and order them to storm it.

steps.title: Gift a teammate
steps.hint: Send a caravan to a teammate's village or to the Holy City vault.
steps.story: "No village stands alone. What you share now comes back to you on the night the walls shake."
how: Build a Caravan Yard on a free plot in the village (no free plot? Upgrade the Elder's Hall: each level opens one).
Open the Caravans tab.
Load resources and send them to a teammate or to the Holy City vault.

solo.title: Fill the Holy City's vault
solo.hint: Send a caravan of resources to the Holy City vault.
solo.story: "The Holy City feeds the bridge and the guard on its walls. What you send now comes back to you on the night the walls shake."
how: Build a Caravan Yard on a free plot in the village (no free plot? Upgrade the Elder's Hall: each level opens one).
Open the Caravans tab.
Load resources and send them to the Holy City vault.

finale.title: Ready for the hordes
finale.story: The elder nods at last. "Now you know the ways of the steppe and the forest. The rest you will learn from the hordes themselves."
